newsitem.title: USA: RPM buys Tremco from BFGoodrich.
newsitem.headline: RPM buys Tremco from BFGoodrich.

text.p: RPM Inc said Monday it had completed its acquisition of Tremco Inc, a BFGoodrich subsidiary, for $230 million in cash.

RPM said the purchase would likely "slightly dilute" its earnings for the quarter ending February 28. It said it expected Tremco to be a "strong contributor" to sales and earnings growth in the 1998 fiscal year, which begins June 1, 1997. BFGoodrich said in a separate statement it expected a pre-tax gain of about $85 million from the sale in the first quarter of 1997.
Based in Cleveland, Tremco makes sealants and coatings sold primarily in building, construction, building maintenance and retail markets.
RPM said it planned to re-pay about half of the purchase price paid for Tremco through the divestiture of a number of Tremco and existing RPM product lines.
Jeffrey Korach, president of Euclid Chemical Co, a joint venture of which RPM was a part, will become president of Tremco, it said.
RPM Inc is a manufacturer of industrial coatings and sealants for waterproofing and general maintenance, corrosion control and other specialty chemical applications.
